<!-- pr-reviewer: 37332ffb0b8d1d45921e3bd4b296ff0fc107fec3 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The checks ran locally after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `2d98d87be18d0711630e6d824b2ccb0dd90e66a4`.
The source and fixture files were not changed in the review worktree.

What looks good:

- Both new refusal tests pass. They check the saved project, embedded model, refusal text, and absence of an NC program.
- The PR includes its decision record and `Process change: yes`. It does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.
- No existing `.nc` or `.cl` golden changes. The new refusal line names Drill1, 400 mm/min, and the tool limit of 115 mm/min.
- No UI code changes. Before/after screenshots do not apply.

Results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Failed both steps. App: 33 passed, 2 failed, 2 ignored. xtask: 268 passed, 1 failed. |
| Adaptive-pocket tests alone, one test thread | Regeneration passed in 51.793 s. Rebuild failed at 60.000 s. |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --only 'app heavy: example_catalog'` | Passed both reached heavy tests: slots regeneration and rebuild. |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed. |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Failed on an unchanged upstream lint at `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67`: `clippy::needless_bool`. |

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test catalog_groove_part_off`: 1 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: 2 passed, 1 ignored screenshot renderer.
- `cargo test -p xtask --test catalog`: 4 passed, 2 failed. Both catalog checks stop at the stale guide links.
- Importer code and STEP fixtures do not change. The additional STEP suites do not apply.

Safety mutations:

I repeated two reported mutations in copies of the new case under `/tmp`. Each run selected both `catalog_2d_drill_overfeed` tests.

1. Change `115 mm/min` to `120 mm/min` in `refusal.txt`: both tests failed with `refusal lines differ from refusal.txt`. Restore: both passed.
2. Lower the operation feeds from 400 to 115 in the script and project: both tests failed. The errors were `the post was not refused` and `build.camscript ended without an error`. Restore: both passed.

Requested before merge:

1. `site/content/guide/operations/operations-2d.md:377`: Refresh the generated example blocks against current main. The new `Slot Undercut` heading has no catalog block. The trial merge is clean, but the link check fails. This also blocks the new `catalog_check_verifies_refusal_case` test. Run the link check again after the refresh.
2. `crates/app/tests/example_catalog/support.rs:339`: Resolve the adaptive-pocket case budget before merge. Both case tests exceed 60 seconds in quick. Rebuild also exceeds 60 seconds alone. The PR reports this failure and links #3163, but the required quick gate remains red. Reduce the case or place its expensive checks in the heavy lane, with the required coverage intact. Run quick again on the final head.

Failure text:

```text
operations/operations-2d.md: example links missing or stale; run `cargo xtask catalog`
2d/adaptive-pocket rebuilds: did not finish within 60s; move this case to app heavy: example_catalog or reduce its model
2d/adaptive-pocket regenerates: did not finish within 60s; move this case to app heavy: example_catalog or reduce its model
```

Notes:

The missing guide block came from current main. The timeout was already disclosed in this PR. These are unresolved checks on the trial merge.
The xtask lint also exists unchanged on current main. It is recorded separately from the two requested changes.
No screenshots, PDFs, or review evidence were committed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. The generated guide links now include the Slot Undercut block from current main. The branch includes a clean merge of `upstream/main`. The new test `committed_slot_undercut_has_its_generated_catalog_block` pins the block and checks all generated links. Removing the block failed the test. Restoring the block passed it.
2. The full adaptive-pocket regeneration and rebuild tests now run in the heavy lane. Their assertions and 60-second budget stay unchanged. The new test `adaptive_pocket_full_case_checks_run_in_the_heavy_lane` pins both test registrations. Removing either ignore attribute failed the test. Each restore passed. The full ignored tests also passed alone in debug: regeneration in 22.716 seconds, rebuild in 22.498 seconds.

Validation:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green. App: 34 passed, 4 ignored. xtask: 270 unit tests and 39 integration tests passed. This includes all six catalog integration tests. The final run used `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1` after automatic seeding caused an artifact mismatch.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: red only at the unchanged upstream `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67` `clippy::needless_bool` finding already recorded in the review. This finding is outside the requested changes.
- The release heavy gate did not run. Both moved full tests ran explicitly with `--ignored` in debug.

New head: `68d83a908044d49fb86b1f480cf00ce701fd9938`.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 68d83a908044d49fb86b1f480cf00ce701fd9938 -->
The review is clean. Both findings from the earlier review are resolved.

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3162`. The trial merge with current `upstream/main` was clean.
The head already includes main at `4d6b75e775064d665a7716d438757ef2689d90c3`.
No GitHub runner was used.

What looks good:

- The generated Slot Undercut block is present. The new link test passes and checks all generated links.
- Both full adaptive-pocket checks run in the heavy lane. Their assertions and 60-second budgets remain intact.
- The refusal checks require the exact error lines, a saved project, an embedded model, and no NC program.
- The decision record explains the choices. The body has `Process change: yes`. This PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.
- No UI code changes. Before/after screenshots do not apply.

Results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed. Catalog: 34 passed, 4 ignored. xtask: 270 unit tests and 39 integration tests passed. |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --only 'app heavy: example_catalog'` | Passed in release. All 4 reached tests passed. |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed. |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Failed only on the unchanged upstream lint below. |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings -A clippy::needless_bool` | Passed with that one lint allowed. |

The heavy run checked adaptive-pocket regeneration in 10.240 seconds and rebuild in 10.145 seconds.
Both slots checks also passed. The release build and tests took 24.7 minutes.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test catalog_groove_part_off`: 1 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: 2 passed, 1 ignored screenshot renderer.
- `cargo test -p xtask --test catalog`: 6 passed. This includes the seed and refusal checks.
- No importer code or STEP fixtures change. The additional STEP suites do not apply.

Safety mutations:

I repeated two reported mutations in copies of the new case under `/tmp`.
Each run selected both `catalog_2d_drill_overfeed` tests.

1. Change `115 mm/min` to `120 mm/min` in `refusal.txt`: both tests failed with `refusal lines differ from refusal.txt`. Restore: both passed.
2. Lower the feeds from 400 to 115 in the script and project: both tests failed. The errors were `the post was not refused` and `build.camscript ended without an error`. Restore: both passed.

Golden check:

No existing `.nc` or `.cl` golden changes or moves.
I checked the new refusal line against the script and project: Drill1 feeds at 400 mm/min; DR-0600 states 115 mm/min.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

The standard combined clippy command is still red. This is the same upstream finding recorded in the earlier review:

```text
error: this `if` guard returns a bool literal and is followed by another
  --> xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67:5
   = note: `-D clippy::needless-bool` implied by `-D warnings`
```

`xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs` is identical to current upstream main. This PR introduces no further clippy failure.
The standard command did not pass; the separate xtask check allowed only this known lint.

The review worktree has no source or fixture changes. No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed or pushed.
Feature changes merge at the release cut under AGENTS.md.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 68d83a908044d49fb86b1f480cf00ce701fd9938 -->
Second read (Opus, read-only): clean

Scope: a read of the diff `4d6b75e77..68d83a908` (34 files). I did not build. The PR is open and not merged. Its base is `main`. `git merge-tree` with `origin/main` is clean.

Commits: `37332ffb0`, a merge of main (`30a2af9d6`), and `68d83a908`. The stack parent #3139 merged at 2026-11-21. The diff has no commits of another open PR.

Findings:

1. A refusal case cannot hide a wrong refusal. The app tests `regenerates` and `rebuilds` and `cargo xtask catalog --check` compare the refusal lines with `refusal.txt` byte for byte. A refusal for a different reason fails. A program that posts fails (`the post was not refused`, `build.camscript ended without an error`). A written `.nc` fails. A run with no refusal lines fails (`xtask/src/catalog_refusal.rs:92`).
2. No case changes from output to refusal. The 12 existing cases change only their `expect` text to `"post"`. Their `.nc` and `.cl` goldens do not change. The only refusal case is the new `2d/drill-overfeed`.
3. The refusal of `2d/drill-overfeed` is correct product behaviour. The Drill feeds at 400 mm/min. Tool DR-0600 states 115 mm/min. The post blocks it by the #2598 clause. This is not a known defect, so it is not a way around the known-fail marker law (#2567).
4. The body has `Process change: yes`. The diff does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
5. The xtask tests pin the mode in the two directions:
   - `catalog_expect_takes_post_or_refusal_only`
   - `catalog_layout_accepts_a_refusal_case_without_nc` (a refusal case with a `.nc` fails)
   - `catalog_layout_still_requires_nc_for_a_post_case`
   - `a_changed_refusal_text_fails_the_check`
   - `catalog_check_verifies_refusal_case`
6. The adaptive-pocket full-case tests move to the heavy lane with a `heavy lane (#3163 ...)` reason. Their assertions stay. The `#[test]` count does not change. `adaptive_pocket_full_case_checks_run_in_the_heavy_lane` pins the two names in the ignored list. The first review ran `app heavy: example_catalog` in release on this head, and it passed.
7. No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` is on a user path. The new xtask code returns `Result` with named errors. The panics are in test code only. All changed source files have 400 lines or fewer (largest: `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs`, 398).

Notes (not blockers):

- The PR body is stale. It says "Stacked on #3139 (merge #3139 first)", but #3139 merged. It reports two adaptive-pocket failures in the gate, and it does not name the heavy-lane move, the two new tests of `68d83a908` or the heavy lane that ran. Update the body before the merge.
- `68d83a908` does part of the work of #3163, which stays open. Add `Refs #3163` to the body, or comment on #3163.
- Only the review stops a later PR that changes a post case to `expect = "refusal"` and deletes its `.nc`. No tool guard catches it. A reviewer must check each change of `expect` from `"post"` to `"refusal"`.
- `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs` has 398 lines. The next case must go into an `include!` file, as `case_2d_drill_overfeed.rs` does.
- This is a `feat` PR. It merges at the cut.

Coordinator: this PR merges by the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-21 ("merge using the recommended option"; a reviewed `feat` merges now). The reviews that this merge relies on, both on head 68d83a908: mkinney's collaborator marker (clean) and the second Opus read (comment 7075568250, clean). The body closes only #2856; #3163 stays open. `main` is green. I merge it on head 68d83a908. It is a fork PR, so its branch stays. A `PROCESS_VERSION` bump follows (xtask/).
